Definition: from G3425 and G2980; hardly talking, i.e. dumb (tongue-tied):--having an impediment in his speech.
BiblicalUsage: Mogilalos means speaking with difficulty, tongue-tied — the deaf man they bring to Jesus, who has an impediment in his speech, and whom Jesus heals with a touch and a word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the healing is the whole gospel in one touch: the man who could hardly speak is given a tongue, and the first thing he does with it is speak plainly.
